rules.rule: Quy tắc chung khi chuyển sang câu gián tiếp: Đổi ngôi, Lùi thì, Đổi trạng từ chỉ thời gian và nơi chốn.
rules.formula: HTĐ -> QKĐ // HTTD -> QKTD // QKĐ/HTHT -> QKHT // will -> would // can -> could // must -> had to
rules.examples: "I am tired now," she said -> She said that she was tired then.

rules.rule: Câu hỏi gián tiếp: Tuyệt đối KHÔNG đảo ngữ, đưa về trật tự khẳng định (S + V).
rules.formula: Yes/No: S + asked + (O) + IF / WHETHER + S + V(lùi thì) // Wh-: S + asked + (O) + Wh-word + S + V(lùi thì)
rules.examples: "Do you like tea?" -> He asked me if I liked tea. / "Where do you live?" -> She asked where I lived.

rules.rule: Câu mệnh lệnh, yêu cầu gián tiếp:
rules.formula: S + told / asked + O + (not) TO V-inf
rules.examples: "Please turn off the lights," the teacher said -> The teacher asked us to turn off the lights.

rules.rule: Cấu trúc với động từ tường thuật đặc biệt SUGGEST:
rules.formula: suggest + V-ing // suggest that + S + (should) + V-inf
rules.examples: He suggested going for a walk. / The doctor suggested that she (should) take a rest.
